summary: PAID, Inc. filed an 8-K on 2026-11-06 reporting Item 1.01 entry into a material definitive agreement: a further extension of its Forbearance and Loan Modification Agreement with Embolx, Inc., effective October 31, 2026, pushing the forbearance through January 31, 2027. The underlying secured convertible note relates to the Company's 2022 $1,875,000 note purchased at a 20% original issue discount; the amended note balance is $5,967,100 carrying a 25% interest rate, repeatedly in default since June 2024. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing condition is stated. The filing is a credit forbearance extension, not a special situation; watch for further extensions or conversion/foreclosure dynamics.
